children.name: Trace Metadata Update
children.description: Programmatically inject or update execution metadata into an active trace during agent processing. Enriches trace logs with runtime context such as operation name, processing stage, record counts, user ID, and custom tags for debugging and monitoring.
children.applicable_when: Programmatically inject or update execution metadata into an active trace during agent processing. Enriches trace logs with runtime context such as operation name, processing stage, record counts, user ID, and custom tags for debugging and monitoring.
selector_terms: Need to log operation name, processing stage, or record count
User context or custom tags must be captured for observability
